new.title: New Group
new.footer: After creating the group, add your contacts and invite people by email.
new.name: Group name
new.disclosure: Group members can see your name and profile photo. Members can read the group's history, including messages sent before they joined, unless they were added without earlier messages. Contacts use what group members have told them, except chats kept private. What you say here can become a shared memory, used in this group and in private chats with its members, never in other groups. Leaving stops access to your contributed group memories; messages remain visible in the group until it is deleted.
new.contributorNote: Your selected model is Contributor. Group messages and shared memories sent to Meta may be used for model training.

chat.consentWaiting: Contacts can't reply in this group until every member gives Contributor consent. Waiting for {names}.

members.sharingInfo: Allow each contact to discuss your entire past and future private text conversation with everyone in this group, including future members. This includes personal details and temporary plans. Only your own conversation is authorized. Attachment files and scheduled messages are excluded; chats with connections and chats you keep private stay private. Turning this off stops pending replies; messages already sent remain visible. Existing shared memories keep their current rules. Unavailable contacts need an eligible private chat.
members.needsPrivateChat: Needs a private chat that isn't kept private
members.addToManage: Add a contact to manage private chat sharing.
members.inviteInfo: They will receive an invitation in Wildcard and can choose whether to join the group. Invitations expire after 24 hours.
members.historyHelp: Off: they'll only see messages from when they join.
members.onlyCreated: Only contacts you created can be added. All of them are already in this group.
members.addDisclosure: Adding this contact lets it use what group members, including you, have told it with everyone in the group, except chats kept private. It remains the same contact in your other chats.
members.contributorNote: Your selected model is Contributor. Messages and memories sent to Meta may be used for model training.
members.inviteSent: Invitation sent to {email}. It appears in their Invitations and expires after 24 hours.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? This removes group access. Previous messages stay visible. Removing a user also removes the contacts they added.
members.privateSharingConfirm: This contact may discuss your entire past and future private text conversation with everyone in this group, including future members. This includes personal details and temporary plans. You can turn this off later, but messages already sent remain visible.
members.deleteConfirm: Delete group? This deletes the group, its messages and memories sourced from those messages for everyone.
members.leaveConfirm: Leave group? Your contacts leave with you. Your messages remain in the group. Your contributed group memories stop being available to contacts, but replies already sent remain visible.
members.consentNeeded: Contacts can't reply in this group until you give Contributor consent.
members.contributorHistoryNote: Meta may use your earlier and future messages, attachments and shared memories in this group for model training with Contributor. Accepting also authorizes your earlier contributions. Other members must authorize their own history; earlier contact replies become available only when all human history is authorized. Existing limits on who can read earlier messages still apply.
members.consentDisclosureWithoutHistory: Group members can see your name and profile photo. You can read messages from when you joined. Contacts use what group members have told them, except chats kept private. What you say here can become a shared memory, used in this group and in private chats with its members, never in other groups. Leaving stops access to your contributed group memories; messages remain visible in the group until it is deleted.

messageInfo.untracked: Read information is unavailable for this older message.

messageInfo.readNote: Read does not mean someone replied. Contacts can acknowledge reading before preparing a response.
